name: Suzuki Burgman 125 / 200
engine: 124 or 199 cc liquid-cooled single, fuel injected, CVT
intro: The small Burgmans. 2018-2020 Burgman 200s had a CVT drive plate recall and a fuel hose recall.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. Some 2018-2019 Burgman 200s are in recall 19V377 (CVT drive plate), and some 2019-2020 bikes in 21V558 (fuel hose).
A-002.reason: A leaking fuel hose is a fire risk. Both fixes are free.

recalls.what: Rivets in the CVT driven face can fail and the drive plate can break.
Fuel hose assembly may leak fuel.
recalls.fix: Dealer replaces the fuel hose assembly free.
